dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are distributed across the anterior and mid-dorsal regions. The outer perimeters are characterized by irregular, high-contrast jagged edges of light grey pixels transitioning sharply into a dark charcoal-colored interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Small, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters are moderately dense across the upper-lateral flank, with a singular, high-contrast white blob located near the posterior-ventral terminus.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest anterior annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. An elongated trapezoidal relationship is formed by connecting the centroids of four prominent mid-body annuli.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp linear contrast boundary exists between the dark dorsal coat and a light-colored ventral margin visible along the lower body edge.
